questDescription->A scholar seeks help comparing a damaged translation with [translationTitle] in your library. Accept to host the scholar for up to 10 days. Keep the scholar alive and on this map.

Place an identified copy on the ground or a shelf. Undraft both participants and keep the scholar awake. Select another colonist and choose Joint research; the scholar will automatically walk to the book. Intellectual skill increases progress; interruptions do not erase it. The original book is kept.

Complete the research to receive a new archive and research notes. No AI connection is required. The scholar leaves when the quest ends.
